scope: Static local source review only. No imports, tests, remote actions, acceptance execution, payload reads, or prediction-array reads were performed.

findings.finding: The native capture validator checks ActiveState/SubState/MainPID/ExecMainCode/ExecMainStatus/Result and joins systemd.InvocationID to the captured invocation, but it does not require systemd.Id to equal the captured unit.
findings.impact: The acceptor does not fully bind the native property object to the exact launched unit, even though the launch acceptance and observation-level unit fields are joined.

findings.finding: The pure scorer metadata helper import checks on-disk pins before and after import and checks module origins, but does not reject preloaded first_cell_score_contract/first_cell_score_core entries in sys.modules or existing __pycache__/.pyc files before import. Setting sys.dont_write_bytecode does not prevent Python from reading an existing cached bytecode file.
findings.impact: A preloaded module object or cached bytecode can supply code that is not demonstrated to be the exact pinned source bytes, weakening the import boundary for the metadata validator.
